# Collins Dictionary

> > Comprehensive online dictionary providing English definitions, pronunciations, synonyms, translations, and language reference tools from Collins.

Collins Dictionary is a trusted language resource offering extensive English dictionary content alongside grammar guides, word game tools (including Scrabble and Wordle helpers), and multilingual translation services. The platform serves learners, writers, and language enthusiasts with authoritative definitions and usage examples.

## Key Topics

- Collins English Dictionary
- English definitions
- Pronunciations
- Synonyms and antonyms
- Word translations
- Grammar reference
- Scrabble word finder
- Wordle solver
- Language learning
- Usage examples
- British and American English
- Etymology
- Thesaurus

## Core Dictionary Resources

- [Collins English Dictionary](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english): Main English dictionary with definitions, pronunciations, and synonyms
